skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to design, recommend, or batch-generate different styles of AI image background / wallpaper / poster-base prompts (图片背景、壁纸、海报底图、材质底图). It produces dimension-organized, copy-ready English structured prompts following an engineering framework, manages a growing manual of all styles, optionally renders a visual color-card gallery, applies a points-saving strategy (give prompts first, generate images only on demand), and matches content types to optimal styles via multi-dimensional scoring (内容→风格匹配). Triggers include phrases like "设计/推荐不同风格的背景或壁纸提示词", "按材质/绘画/UI/节日/美食等维度出图提示词", "XX类内容适合什么风格", and keywords 图片背景、绘图提示词、贴图(旧称)、背景、prompt 工程、风格库、风格匹配.
